summary: When multiple distinct qualifying GUT triage provenances agree on one contamination classification, VAJRA correctly audited all qualifying receipts at the top-level decomposition result but generated downstream facets inherited only the canonical representative triageProvenanceFingerprint. A facet routed independently could therefore lose the full set of contributors that caused the behavioral change.
expectedRepair: Every generated facet must carry a deterministic de-identified set of all qualifying contributor provenance fingerprints, while retaining the representative fingerprint for backward compatibility. Provenance diversity must remain an audit fact and must not be promoted into a claim of source independence or truth.
risk: provenance loss across GUT -> VAJRA -> downstream organ routing
later organ may treat a multi-source behavioral regulation as if it came from one representative source
auditability becomes dependent on retaining the parent envelope rather than traveling with the metabolized branch

evidence.source: repository static inspection plus CI verification
evidence.privacy: de-identified repository evidence only; no private connector identifiers or source text

preservedRedRun.reason: the initial repair accidentally removed the pre-existing singular top-level diagnosticFingerprint field; the failure was retained and fixed rather than hidden

resolution: All distinct qualifying GUT contributor provenance and diagnostic fingerprints that jointly regulate one VAJRA decomposition now travel with every generated facet. The canonical representative fingerprint is retained for backward compatibility. Contributor diversity remains explicitly non-evidential with respect to independence or truth.
boundary: This historical record remains in the repository after resolution. It does not claim any source is independent or true, and the green verification does not erase the earlier failed repair run.
